messages.subject: Whitmore — draft Settlement Agreement (v1) for your review
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Eleanor, Deepa,

Further to acceptance, please find the first draft of the Settlement Agreement (v1). It reflects the agreed £185,000 termination payment, £5,000+VAT fees contribution, mutual confidentiality and non-derogatory undertakings, and the agreed reference at Schedule 2. Grateful for any comments and for Deepa to confirm she will act as relevant independent adviser.

Best,
Tom Gallagher
Whitfield Carter LLP

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ | www.whitfieldcarter.com
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Whitmore — draft Settlement Agreement (v1) for your review
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Tom,

Thank you. I confirm I will act as relevant independent adviser. Our mark-up follows separately with tracked changes — the main points are (i) reducing the payment window to 14 days, (ii) broadening the non-derogatory undertaking to cover directors as well as the senior leadership team, and (iii) a confidentiality carve-out allowing our client to explain the reason for leaving to a prospective employer, consistent with the reference. Subject to those, we are content.

Deepa Kovac
Ashworth Quinn LLP
